say:1:1711138001:1.text: Returned to its rightful owner at last.
say:1:1711138001:1.source_cn: 终于物归原主了，在下也算是不负所托。

say:1:1711138001:1.female: Returned to its rightful owner at last.

say:2:1711138002:1.text: You must realize that neither the Twilight Pavilion nor the Solitaries typically offer safekeeping services.
say:2:1711138002:1.source_cn: 您要知道，本来不论是霁月会馆，还是隐士，都不提供替人保...

say:2:1711138002:1.female: You must realize that neither the Twilight Pavilion nor the Solitaries typically offer safekeeping services.

say:3:1711138003:1.text: But who was I to refuse... when the matter was brokered by a certain grand figure I could never turn down.
say:3:1711138003:1.source_cn: 可谁让这件事……是被一位在下无论如何也无法拒绝的大人物...
say:3:1711138003:1.male: But who was I to refuse... when the matter was brokered by a certain grand figure I could never turn down.
say:3:1711138003:1.female: But who was I to refuse... when the matter was brokered by a certain grand figure I could never turn down.

say:5:1711138004:1.text: To think you can't even remember that, yet you managed to recite the password flawlessly...
say:5:1711138004:1.source_cn: 您连这个都不记得，竟然还能准确无误地说出暗号……
say:5:1711138004:1.male: To think you can't even remember that, yet you managed to recite the password flawlessly...
say:5:1711138004:1.female: To think you can't even remember that, yet you managed to recite the password flawlessly...

say:6:1711138005:1.text: I'm beginning to think I may have returned this a little too quickly.
say:6:1711138005:1.source_cn: 在下突然有些后悔了，不应该直接还给您才是。

say:8:1711138006:1.text: A client's privacy is absolute top secret. As for that individual's identity... my lips are sealed tighter than ever.
say:8:1711138006:1.source_cn: 客户的个人隐私是顶级机密，至于那位的身份……在下更是要保密。

say:9:1711138007:1.text: My apologies, Magister Merlin. No matter how valuable the intelligence you bring me, this is one secret I cannot share.
say:9:1711138007:1.source_cn: 抱歉了，梅林阁下，这次就算你拿来再独家的情报，我也无法...

say:11:1711138008:1.text: Certainly not. I possess professional ethics.
say:11:1711138008:1.source_cn: 怎么会呢？在下有基本的职业操守。
say:11:1711138008:1.male: Certainly not. I possess professional ethics.
say:11:1711138008:1.female: Certainly not. I possess professional ethics.

say:12:1711138009:1.text: Besides, that is a magical seal placed by you personally. With my shallow understanding of magic, I couldn't unseal it even if curiosity kept me awake at night.

say:13:1711138010:1.male: I merely happen to know a few harmless details surrounding it.
say:13:1711138010:1.female: I merely happen to know a few harmless details surrounding it.

say:14:1711138011:1.text: As for what world-shattering secret lies within this Memory Star, I leave it to you to unseal it yourself.
say:14:1711138011:1.source_cn: 至于这颗记忆之星里究竟藏着什么惊天秘密，就请阁下自行解封吧。
